reviews.title: Off color.Functional product.Limited customization
reviews.review_text: The color is definitely Not metallic. I had to check the box to make sure the right one was delivered. It's clearly more of a taupe. Quick assembly. Easily adjustable. Not as sturdy as I expected, but sufficient. Baskets are only able to be adjusted on the bottom portion of the pole. The highest position of the top basket is about 33 inches from the base.
